```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: involvement
# Every player named on a scrimmage play, with the play's EPA split evenly
# among the players named on each side; the typical play of a position group
# is the average EPA per involvement over both teams.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
rated <- dplyr::filter(epa, !is.na(ppa))
inv <- game_involvement(con, game_id, 2026, rated, c(home, away))
involvement <- game_group_typical(inv$involvement) |>
  mutate(team = factor(team, c(away, home)))
groups <- involvement |>
  distinct(group, typical)
groups_team <- involvement |>
  summarise(
    involvements = n(),
    per_inv = mean(epa_side),
    median = median(epa_side),
    .by = c(group, team)
  ) |>
  left_join(groups, by = "group") |>
  mutate(vs_typical = per_inv - typical)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(groups_team, aes(per_inv, factor(group, rev(levels(groups$group))))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    data = groups,
    aes(typical, factor(group, rev(levels(groups$group)))),
    shape = "|",
    size = 9,
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      color = team,
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        team,
        " ",
        group,
        "</b><br>",
        involvements,
        " involvements, ",
        round(per_inv, 2),
        " EPA per involvement<br>Typical play: ",
        round(typical, 2)
      ),
      data_id = paste(group, team)
    ),
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "EPA per involvement by position group",
    subtitle = "Dots: team averages. Ticks: typical play",
    x = "EPA per involvement",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-player-epa-by-position-group", release = release)
card_interactive(
  ggplot(involvement, aes(epa_side, team)) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = groups,
      aes(xintercept = typical),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point_interactive(
      aes(
        color = team,
        tooltip = paste0(
          "<b>",
          label,
          "</b> (",
          team,
          ")<br>",
          playText,
          "<br>Play EPA for ",
          team,
          ": ",
          round(epa_side, 2)
        ),
        data_id = id
      ),
      position = ggbeeswarm::position_quasirandom(orientation = "y", width = 0.25),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_color_team(teams, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x = "Play EPA for the player's side; dashed line is the group's typical play",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Every involvement, by position group"
    ) +
    theme_card(base_size = 14)
  ,
  width_svg = 12,
  height_svg = 9
)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
groups_team |>
  arrange(group, team) |>
  transmute(
    Group = as.character(group),
    Team = as.character(team),
    Involvements = involvements,
    `EPA per involvement` = round(per_inv, 2),
    `Typical play` = round(typical, 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Position group", "Team", "Involvements", "EPA per involvement", "Typical play"),
    caption = "Involvements and average EPA per involvement by position group and team; the typical play is the average over both teams."
  )
```
